title: A degree-p presentation with a unit derivation
statement: Let A be a complete Noetherian local domain with fraction field K, and C a complete Noetherian local A-algebra with local structure map, formally smooth for its maximal-ideal-adic topology [def-weil-pbc-formally-smooth-adic]. Let L/K be finite purely inseparable [def-weil-pbc-finite-purely-inseparable-extension], with K of prime characteristic p, and M an intermediate field with [L:M] = p. Give M and L their compatible A-algebra structures. Then for R = M tensor_A C [def-weil-module-base-change], there exist f in R, a Z-derivation D of R with D(f) a unit, and a ring isomorphism R[z]/(z^p-f) to L tensor_A C. No regularity hypothesis is required.

source.place: Proposition Tag 07PM, proof of (4) => (1), coefficient reduction and final two paragraphs; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07PM

proof.text: Apply the final-step consequence of the pth-root tower to L/M (which is finite purely inseparable of prime degree p). It gives beta, g in M, L = M(beta), beta^p = g, g not a pth power in M, and L isomorphic over M to M[z]/(z^p-g).

Choose a finite K-basis m_i of M. Pure inseparability gives m_i^q_i = a_i/s_i in K for q_i a p-power and s_i nonzero in A. Then (s_i m_i)^q_i = s_i^(q_i-1)a_i lies in A. The monic equation shows these rescaled generators integral. Their A-adjoin A' is module-finite by integral generators. Its fraction field is M: clear the coefficients of any K-linear combination of the m_i, multiplying also by the product of the s_i. Write g = c/e in Frac(A'), e nonzero. Replace beta by e beta and g by f0 = e^p g = e^(p-1)c. This leaves L and degree p unchanged and keeps f0 non-pth-power.
A' is a domain of characteristic p, finite type over the complete Noetherian local A, with fraction field M. Apply 07PH to f0 to obtain D0 : A' -> A' with D0(f0) nonzero.

Base change makes C' = C tensor_A A' formally smooth over A' for the extended maximal ideal of C. Finite module generators of A' make C' finite over C. Finite-module completeness gives completeness for the maximal ideal of C; its powers acting on C' equal the powers of the extended ideal. Apply 07PL to extend D0 to C'.

Localize C' at the images of nonzero A' elements. Tensor cancellation and localization base change identify it with C tensor_A M. Extend the derivation by the localization formula. Its value on f0 is the image of D0(f0), which is invertible since it is nonzero in M.

Tensor the presentation L = M[z]/(z^p-f0) with C tensor_A M. Polynomial scalar extension and quotient base change give the quotient of (C tensor_A M)[z] by z^p-f0. Commuting tensor factors transports the derivation, f0 and ring equivalence to R = M tensor_A C. No regularity assumption was used. If R is zero, the same quotient is zero and D(f) is its (unique) unit.

theorem exists_degree_p_presentation_unit_derivation_of_formallySmoothAdic
    (A : Type u) (C : Type v) (K : Type u) (L : Type w)
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    [CommRing C] [IsLocalRing C] [IsNoetherianRing C]
    [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra A C] [Algebra A K] [Algebra K L] [Algebra A L]
    [IsScalarTower A K L] [IsFractionRing A K] [Module.Finite K L]
    [IsPurelyInseparable K L]
    [IsLocalHom (algebraMap A C)]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal C) C]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP K p]
    (M : IntermediateField K L) [Algebra A M] [IsScalarTower A K M]
    (hdegree : Module.finrank M L = p)
    (hfs : FormallySmoothAdic A C (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal C)) :
    ∃ (f : TensorProduct A M C) (D : Derivation ℤ (TensorProduct A M C)
      (TensorProduct A M C)), IsUnit (D f) ∧
      Nonempty ((Polynomial (TensorProduct A M C) ⧸
        Ideal.span {Polynomial.X ^ p - Polynomial.C f}) ≃+* TensorProduct A L C)
